shots.scene: 欣欣站在一栋实验楼模型前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a small model of a laboratory building and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊：生物安全实验室谁来管。
overlay: 生物风险管理导论：设施管理

shots.scene: 阿杰在走廊里看到老李在修设备，王老师在检查，老周在开会
shots.prompt_en: In a corridor, the young male student sees the facility engineer repairing a unit, the safety administrator inspecting a door and the older man in a meeting room.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，实验室里人人都在忙。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头上三个问号分别指向三人
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, with three question marks pointing to three different people.
shots.narration: 出了问题，到底该找谁？

shots.scene: 小研拿出一张空白组织结构图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank organization chart.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看看这张结构图。

shots.scene: 结构图展开，最上面一个方框，下面三个方框
shots.prompt_en: The blank organization chart unfolds: one box on top and three boxes below it. No people.
shots.narration: 一个生物安全实验室，怎么组织，怎么分工。

shots.section_title: 生物安全委员会定政策
shots.scene: 会议桌旁几个人围坐，桌上空白文件
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the safety administrator and the facility engineer sit around a meeting table with blank documents.
shots.narration: 最上面，是机构的生物安全委员会。
overlay: 生物安全委员会定政策

shots.section_title: 生物安全委员会定政策
shots.scene: 委员会桌上的文件盖上印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy document on the table receives an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 这个实验室的政策，由它来定。

shots.scene: 委员会方框下方伸出几根支撑柱
shots.prompt_en: Several support pillars rise under the committee box on the chart. No people.
shots.narration: 委员会背后，有几方在支撑：

shots.scene: 支撑柱上分别是扳手、盾牌、楼房图标
shots.prompt_en: The pillars carry a wrench icon, a shield icon and an office building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 设施经理、生物安全员，还有相关部门。

shots.scene: 一张实验楼图纸旁边放着一个钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank building blueprint next to a money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 决定建实验室，先要算笔账。

shots.scene: 两个钱袋：一个在施工吊车旁，一个在运转的风机旁
shots.prompt_en: Two money bag icons: one beside a construction crane, one beside a running ventilation fan. No people.
shots.narration: 建起来要花钱，运行起来也要花钱。

shots.scene: 委员会桌旁：一侧是拿文件夹的管理人员，一侧是拿仪器图标的专家
shots.prompt_en: At the committee table, the older man holds a folder while the safety administrator and the facility engineer show equipment icons.
shots.narration: 委员会里，有管理人员，也有技术专家。

shots.scene: 委员会方框箭头指向设施经理方框
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the committee box down to the facility manager box on the chart. No people.
shots.narration: 它通过设施经理，监督设施运行。

shots.section_title: 设施经理：懂工程，也懂生物安全
shots.scene: 老李在设备层检查控制柜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a control cabinet in a plant room.
shots.narration: 设施经理，应当是合格的工程师。
overlay: 设施经理：懂工程，也懂生物安全

shots.section_title: 设施经理：懂工程，也懂生物安全
shots.scene: 老李拿着空白维护日历，旁边扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank maintenance calendar next to a wrench icon.
shots.narration: 管设施运行，管日常维护，

shots.section_title: 设施经理：懂工程，也懂生物安全
shots.scene: 警示灯闪烁，老李快步赶去
shots.prompt_en: A warning light flashes and the facility engineer hurries toward it with a toolbox.
shots.narration: 设备出故障，也由他组织抢修。

shots.section_title: 设施经理：懂工程，也懂生物安全
shots.scene: 老李在读一本空白的生物安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads a blank biosafety manual during a break.
shots.narration: 工程出身，也要懂生物安全规程。

shots.section_title: 生物安全员：有权指出违规
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表，站在实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a laboratory door holding a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 生物安全员，受过专门训练：
overlay: 生物安全员：有权指出违规

shots.section_title: 生物安全员：有权指出违规
shots.scene: 天平、盾牌、对勾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a balance scale, a shield and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，落实控制，检查成效。

shots.section_title: 生物安全员：有权指出违规
shots.scene: 王老师举起一面小黄旗，指向一个敞开的柜门
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator raises a small yellow flag, pointing at a cabinet sash left wide open.
shots.narration: 发现防护破坏或违规，有权指出来。

shots.section_title: 项目负责人：管好自己的实验
shots.scene: 老周在办公室写空白实验方案
shots.prompt_en: The older man writes a blank experiment plan in his office.
shots.narration: 具体病原怎么防，
overlay: 项目负责人：管好自己的实验

shots.section_title: 项目负责人：管好自己的实验
shots.scene: 实验方案上一个病原图标和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank experiment plan with a microbe icon and a shield icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 不由生物安全员定，是项目负责人的事。

shots.section_title: 项目负责人：管好自己的实验
shots.scene: 老周带着阿杰在实验室里做实验
shots.prompt_en: The older man supervises the young male student working at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 他带着团队，对实验本身负责。

shots.scene: 结构图：委员会在上，下面三个方框亮起
shots.prompt_en: The chart: committee on top, three boxes below lighting up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来看：委员会统管全局，

shots.scene: 扳手方框亮起，旁边风机图标
shots.prompt_en: The wrench box lights up beside a ventilation fan icon. No people.
shots.narration: 设施经理管设备运转，

shots.scene: 盾牌方框亮起
shots.prompt_en: The shield box lights up beside a balance icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全员管评估、控制和检查，

shots.scene: 试管方框亮起
shots.prompt_en: The test tube box lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 项目负责人管实验本身。

shots.scene: 三个方框之间用齿轮连起来一起转动
shots.prompt_en: The three boxes linked by gears that turn together. No people.
shots.narration: 三方要互相配合，步调一致。

shots.section_title: 现场由生物安全员监督
shots.scene: 王老师在实验室里巡查，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the laboratory with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 在实验室现场，
overlay: 现场由生物安全员监督

shots.section_title: 现场由生物安全员监督
shots.scene: 阿杰按王老师指点调整操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adjusts his work after the safety administrator points something out.
shots.narration: 生物安全员有权监督日常运行。

shots.section_title: 白纸黑字的生物安全政策
shots.scene: 一份装订好的空白政策文件，封面盖章
shots.prompt_en: A bound blank policy document with an official stamp on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室，都要有书面的生物安全政策。
overlay: 白纸黑字的生物安全政策

shots.section_title: 白纸黑字的生物安全政策
shots.scene: 文件上浮现盾牌和锁两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a padlock icon appear above the document. No people.
shots.narration: 写明单位对生物安全和安保的承诺。

shots.scene: 五个小图标排成一行：靶心、刻度尺、台阶、地球、日历
shots.prompt_en: Five small icons in a row: a target, a ruler, a step, a globe and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 政策不能空喊口号。

shots.scene: 靶心和日历图标被打勾
shots.prompt_en: The target and calendar icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 要具体、能衡量、做得到、有时限。

shots.scene: 政策文件下方展开一本厚厚的空白手册
shots.prompt_en: Below the policy document, a thick blank manual opens. No people.
shots.narration: 政策之下，是生物安全手册。

shots.scene: 手册里画着本实验室的平面图图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual shows a floor plan icon of one specific laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 手册只写本实验室，要具体可用。

shots.scene: 地球图标、外国机构图标和本地标准书并排
shots.prompt_en: A globe document icon, a foreign agency building icon and a local standards book side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 依据国际、国外和本地的指南编写。

shots.scene: 手册旁出现本国国旗形状的空白图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank flag-shaped icon appears beside the manual, with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 各地还要符合本国的要求。

shots.scene: 结构图上半部分是决策，下半部分是执行
shots.prompt_en: The chart split in two: a decision gavel icon on top and working hands icons below. No people.
shots.narration: 上面管理层决策，下面各岗位执行。

shots.scene: 两个柱子：一根很高的建设费，一根逐年增长的运行费
shots.prompt_en: Two bars: one tall bar for construction, and a row of bars growing year by year for operation. No people.
shots.narration: 钱分两块：建设费和运行费。

shots.scene: 运行费被分成小块，落到一排试管上
shots.prompt_en: The operation cost bar splits into small pieces that land on a row of test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 运行费，会摊到每一次实验里。

shots.scene: 老李看着设计图，旁边扳手和日历
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reviews a blank design drawing with a wrench and a calendar icon beside it.
shots.narration: 设计时就要把维护费算进去。

shots.scene: 一栋漂亮的实验楼里风机停转、蒙上灰尘，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fine laboratory building with stopped fans covered in dust, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 建起来是一回事，运行好是另一回事。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一摞空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a stack of blank lecture notes.
shots.narration: 更多细节，可以看课程讲义。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在组织结构图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the organization chart.
shots.narration: 委员会定政策，三方协同各管一摊。

shots.scene: 政策文件、手册、钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a policy document, a manual and a money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 政策有承诺，手册接地气，养护要算账。

shots.scene: 生物安全员举黄旗、项目负责人写方案的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a raised yellow flag and a person writing a blank experiment plan. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员现场监督，负责人管实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老李、王老师、老周站在实验楼前一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with the facility engineer, the safety administrator and the older man in front of the laboratory building, all waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 分工明确，安全有人管，下次见！
